name: Storm of Arrows
body:
School divination; Level inquisitor 6, ranger 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, F (a bow you are wielding)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round

DESCRIPTION

With a primal word of strength you channel the might the might of the storm into your bow. After casting this spell you may use a full round action to make a single attack at your highest base attack bonus against each enemy within the first range increment of your bow.
